subject.title: feat(irc): support markdown messages via draft/multiline

question: Should bundled IRC adopt the draft/multiline extension after the protocol defects are fixed, or should this remain out of core until an IRC owner sponsors the behavior?
rationale: The PR adds a new draft IRCv3 extension path and changes compatibility-sensitive IRC message delivery; code repair is necessary, but acceptance of the draft extension is still a maintainer product/ownership decision.

options.title: Repair and reconsider
options.body: Ask for a rebase and protocol-complete repair, then reconsider the feature after tests and raw CAP/BATCH proof are present.

options.title: Narrow outbound only
options.body: Sponsor only outbound multiline sends first and defer inbound BATCH reconstruction until concat and limit behavior are designed.

options.title: Pause draft adoption
options.body: Close or pause this PR if bundled IRC should not ship draft/multiline until the extension stabilizes or a channel owner takes it on.

recommendation.title: Repair and reconsider
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase and protocol-complete repair, then reconsider the feature after tests and raw CAP/BATCH proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and helped carry the original first-class IRC channel PR, making them the best available owner signal for accepting new bundled IRC protocol behavior.
